# Isaiah Chapter 9 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**9:1** But-there-will-be-no [ki lo] gloom [mu'af] for-her-who [la-asher] was-in-anguish [mutzaq lah]. In-the-former-time [ka-et ha-rishon] he-brought-contempt [heqal] on-the-land [artzah] of-Zebulun [Zevulun] and-the-land [ve-artzah] of-Naphtali [Naftali], but-in-the-latter-time [ve-ha-acharon] he-has-made-glorious [hikhbid] the-way [derekh] of-the-sea [ha-yam], beyond [ever] the-Jordan [ha-Yarden], Galilee [Gelil] of-the-nations [ha-goyim].

**9:2** The-people [ha-am] who-walked [ha-holkhim] in-darkness [ba-choshekh] have-seen [ra'u] a-great [gadol] light [or]; those-who-dwelt [yoshevei] in-the-land [be-eretz] of-deep-darkness [tzalmavet] — light [or] has-shone [nagah] upon-them [alehem].

**9:3** You-have-multiplied [hirbita] the-nation [ha-goi]; you-have-increased [higdalta] the-joy [ha-simchah]. They-rejoice [samechu] before-you [lefanekha] like-the-joy [ke-simchat] of-harvest [ba-qatzir], as they-are-glad [ka-asher yagilu] when-they-divide [be-challeqam] spoil [shalal].

**9:4** For the-yoke [ol] of-his-burden [subbolo] and-the-staff [u-matteh] of-his-shoulder [shikhmo], the-rod [shevet] of-his-oppressor [ha-noges bo] — you-have-shattered [hachittota] as-on-the-day [ke-yom] of-Midian [Midyan].

**9:5** For every [ki khol] boot [se'on] of-the-one-who-tramped [so'en] with-shaking [be-ra'ash] and-every-garment [ve-simlah] rolled [megolalah] in-blood [be-damim] shall-be [ve-hayetah] for-burning [li-serefah], fuel [ma'akholet] for-fire [esh].

**9:6** For a-child [yeled] is-born [yullad] to-us [lanu], a-son [ben] is-given [nittan] to-us [lanu]; and-the-government [ha-misrah] is upon his-shoulder [al shikhmo]; and-his-name [va-yiqra shemo] is-called [shemo] Wonderful [Pele] Counselor [Yo'etz], Mighty [El] God [Gibbor], Everlasting [Avi Ad] Father, Prince [Sar] of-Peace [Shalom].

**9:7** Of-the-increase [le-marbeh] of-his-government [ha-misrah] and-of-peace [u-le-shalom] there-is-no [ein] end [qetz], upon the-throne [al kisse] of-David [David] and-upon his-kingdom [ve-al mamlakhto], to-establish-it [le-hakhin otah] and-to-uphold-it [u-le-sa'adah] with-justice [be-mishpat] and-with-righteousness [u-vi-tzdaqah] from-now [me-attah] and-forever [ve-ad olam]. The-zeal [qin'at] of-the-LORD [YHVH] of-hosts [Tzeva'ot] will-do [ta'aseh] this [zot].

**9:8** The-Lord [Adonai] has-sent [shalach] a-word [davar] against-Jacob [be-Ya'akov], and-it-has-fallen [ve-nafal] on-Israel [be-Yisra'el].

**9:9** And-all-the-people [ve-yade'u ha-am kullo] shall-know — Ephraim [Efrayim] and-the-inhabitants [ve-yoshev] of-Samaria [Shomeron] — who-say [ha-omerim] in-pride [be-ga'avah] and-in-greatness [u-ve-godel] of-heart [levav]:

**9:10** "Bricks [levenim] have-fallen [nafalu], but-with-cut-stone [ve-gazit] we-will-build [nivneh]; sycamores [shiqmim] have-been-cut-down [gudda'u], but-with-cedars [va-arazim] we-will-replace [nachalif] [them]."

**9:11** And-the-LORD [va-yesaggev YHVH] raises [et] the-adversaries [tzarei] of-Rezin [Retzin] against-him [alav] and-stirs-up [ve-et oyvav] his-enemies [yesakhsekh].

**9:12** Syria [Aram] from-the-east [mi-qedem] and-Philistines [u-Felishtim] from-the-west [me-achor]; and-they-devour [va-yokhelu] Israel [et Yisra'el] with-open [be-khol] mouth [peh]. For-all-this [be-khol zot] his-anger [appo] has-not-turned-back [lo shav], and-his-hand [ve-yado] [is] stretched-out [netuyah] still [od].

**9:13** And-the-people [ve-ha-am] did-not-turn [lo shav] to the-one-who-struck-them [ad ha-makkehhu], and-the-LORD [ve-et YHVH] of-hosts [Tzeva'ot] they-did-not-seek [lo darashu].

**9:14** And-the-LORD [va-yakhret YHVH] cuts-off [me-Yisra'el] from-Israel head [rosh] and-tail [ve-zanav], palm-branch [kippah] and-reed [ve-agmon], in-one [yom] day [echad].

**9:15** The-elder [zaqen] and-the-honored [u-nesu fanim] — he [hu] [is] the-head [ha-rosh]; and-the-prophet [ve-navi] who-teaches [moreh] lies [sheqer] — he [hu] [is] the-tail [ha-zanav].

**9:16** And-the-leaders [va-yihyu me'ashrei] of-this [ha-am ha-zeh] people lead-astray [mat'im], and-those-who-are-led [u-me'usharav] are-swallowed-up [mevulla'im].

**9:17** Therefore [al ken], upon their-young-men [al bachurai] the-Lord [Adonai] does-not-rejoice [lo yismach], and-upon their-orphans [ve-et yetomav] and-their-widows [ve-et almenotav] he-has-no-compassion [lo yerachem]; for everyone [ki khullo] [is] godless [chanef] and-an-evildoer [u-mere'a], and-every [ve-khol] mouth [peh] speaks [dover] folly [nevalah]. For-all-this [be-khol zot] his-anger [appo] has-not-turned-back [lo shav], and-his-hand [ve-yado] [is] stretched-out [netuyah] still [od].

**9:18** For wickedness [ki va'arah kha-esh] burns [ha-rish'ah] like-a-fire; thorns [shamir] and-briers [va-shayit] it-devours [tokhal], and-it-kindles [va-tittzath] the-thickets [be-sivkhei] of-the-forest [ha-ya'ar], and-they-roll-upward [va-yit'abkhu] in-a-column [ge'ut] of-smoke [ashan].

**9:19** By-the-wrath [be-evrat] of-the-LORD [YHVH] of-hosts [Tzeva'ot] the-land [ha-aretz] is-scorched [ne'tam], and-the-people [ve-yehi ha-am] are-like-fuel [ke-ma'akholet] for-fire [esh]; no-one [ish] has-pity [lo yachmol] on-his-brother [el achiv].

**9:20** They-snatch [va-yigzor] on-the-right [al yamin] and-are-hungry [ve-ra'ev], and-they-devour [va-yokhal] on-the-left [al semol] and-are-not-satisfied [ve-lo save'u]; each-one [ish] devours [yokhelu] the-flesh [besar] of-his-own-arm [zero'o].

**9:21** Manasseh [Menasheh] [devours] Ephraim [et Efrayim], and-Ephraim [ve-Efrayim] [devours] Manasseh [et Menasheh]; together [yachdav] they [hemmah] are-against [al] Judah [Yehudah]. For-all-this [be-khol zot] his-anger [appo] has-not-turned-back [lo shav], and-his-hand [ve-yado] [is] stretched-out [netuyah] still [od].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — "the people who walked in darkness":** The geographical reference (Zebulun, Naphtali, Galilee of the nations) points to the northern territories most affected by Assyrian conquest. Light breaking into this specific darkness is both historical (liberation from Assyria) and eschatological.

**v.6 — The four throne names:** *Pele Yo'etz* ("Wonderful Counselor"), *El Gibbor* ("Mighty God"), *Avi Ad* ("Everlasting Father"), *Sar Shalom* ("Prince of Peace"). Whether these are four names or two pairs is debated. The title *El Gibbor* ("Mighty God") is extraordinary — *El* is a divine name, making this a claim of divine status for the royal child.

**v.12, 17, 21 — The refrain:** "His anger has not turned back, and his hand is stretched out still" appears four times in this section (9:12, 17, 21; 10:4), structuring the oracle of judgment like stanzas of a poem.

*-- EMET*
